title: 伊泰普水壩
summary: 伊泰普提供同一水力系統連結不同電網頻率的案例。學員從同步轉速、換流損失及無功容量出發，再追蹤尾水耦合、洩洪動量、冷卻與振動，最後建立跨時區資料帳。課程把電力份額與水量分配分開處理，避免將制度安排誤認為固定物理分流比例。
summaryEn: Itaipu illustrates one hydraulic development linked to grids with different frequencies. Learners examine synchronous speed, converter loss and reactive capacity before tailwater coupling, spillway momentum, cooling, vibration and time-aligned records. Electrical allocation and water distribution are handled separately, preventing institutional arrangements from being mistaken for a fixed physical flow split.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頻率極數與轉速」與「異頻換流能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Frequency poles and speed" and "Asynchronous conversion energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Frequency poles and speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頻率極數與轉速」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency poles and speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。比較兩種頻率時應先寫清楚總極數而非極對數，再檢查轉輪水力設計所允許的轉速。電網頻率不同不表示兩台機組的轉輪幾何可以不經分析直接互換。 磁極數選擇也影響發電機幾何與轉輪匹配，因此頻率介面應由機械與電氣團隊共同確認，不能只改控制設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻率極數與轉速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster. State total poles rather than pole pairs when comparing frequencies, then check the speed allowed by the hydraulic design. Different grid frequencies do not make runner geometries interchangeable without analysis. Pole selection also affects generator geometry and runner matching, so mechanical and electrical teams must jointly verify a frequency interface rather than merely changing control settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frequency poles and speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頻率極數與轉速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Frequency poles and speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頻率極數與轉速
knowledge.text: 同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。比較兩種頻率時應先寫清楚總極數而非極對數，再檢查轉輪水力設計所允許的轉速。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster. State total poles rather than pole pairs when comparing frequencies, then check the speed allowed by the hydraulic design.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻率極數與轉速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frequency poles and speed" is correct?
options: 只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯
同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。
不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失
optionsEn: Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency.
Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster.
Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss.
quiz.explanation: 同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency poles and speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率極數與轉速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency poles and speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。模型邊界：理想同步轉速，極數為總磁極數；不是伊泰普實際機組銘牌。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm. Model boundary: ideal synchronous speed using total magnetic poles, not an Itaipu machine nameplate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。模型邊界：理想同步轉速，極數為總磁極數；不是伊泰普實際機組銘牌。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm. Model boundary: ideal synchronous speed using total magnetic poles, not an Itaipu machine nameplate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頻率極數與轉速」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Frequency poles and speed", which statement holds?
options: 每台機組出力永遠與其他機組無關
冷卻水流量正常就保證所有熱點安全
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。
optionsEn: Each unit output is always independent of the other units.
Normal cooling-water flow guarantees that every local hotspot is safe.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Frequency poles and speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻率極數與轉速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frequency poles and speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。若頻率正確但顯示轉速倍增，先查極對數與脈衝換算，不要由儀表顯示直接推定水輪機發生超速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer. If frequency is correct but displayed speed doubles, investigate pole-pair conventions and pulse conversion before interpreting the display as physical turbine overspeed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同總極數計算另一頻率的轉速，並畫出轉速與頻率關係，再說明若維持原轉速，所需極數為何必須是可製造的整數配置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate speed at another frequency using the same total poles. Plot the relationship and explain why retaining the original speed requires an integer pole arrangement that can actually be constructed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。若頻率正確但顯示轉速倍增，先查極對數與脈衝換算，不要由儀表顯示直接推定水輪機發生超速。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer. If frequency is correct but displayed speed doubles, investigate pole-pair conventions and pulse conversion before interpreting the display as physical turbine overspeed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用相同總極數計算另一頻率的轉速，並畫出轉速與頻率關係，再說明若維持原轉速，所需極數為何必須是可製造的整數配置。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate speed at another frequency using the same total poles. Plot the relationship and explain why retaining the original speed requires an integer pole arrangement that can actually be constructed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻率極數與轉速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Frequency poles and speed"?
options: 將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
日總量吻合就保證每小時資料對齊
optionsEn: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Matching daily totals guarantees that hourly records are aligned.
quiz.explanation: 將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Frequency poles and speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率極數與轉速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frequency poles and speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. The synchronous relation applies after synchronization; startup and disconnected transients cannot be forced to follow it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：磁極數選擇也影響發電機幾何與轉輪匹配，因此頻率介面應由機械與電氣團隊共同確認，不能只改控制設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pole selection also affects generator geometry and runner matching, so mechanical and electrical teams must jointly verify a frequency interface rather than merely changing control settings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. The synchronous relation applies after synchronization; startup and disconnected transients cannot be forced to follow it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻率極數與轉速」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Frequency poles and speed" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。
不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations.
Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss.
quiz.explanation: 總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「異頻換流能量」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asynchronous conversion energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。教材以輸入電量乘總效率求接收電量，只描述能量帳，不把它當成電壓穩定或故障穿越分析。每個效率都要附邊界，避免把線路損失同時算入兩次。 換流損失可包含固定輔助耗電及隨負載改變的部分，低負載效率因此未必與額定點相同，需保留負載曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「異頻換流能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints. Multiplying input energy by overall efficiency describes the energy account only, not voltage stability or fault behavior. Each efficiency needs a boundary so that line losses are not included twice in the same transfer estimate. Conversion losses can include fixed auxiliaries and load-dependent components, making low-load efficiency differ from the rated point; retain the load curve in comparisons. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asynchronous conversion energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「異頻換流能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asynchronous conversion energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 異頻換流能量
knowledge.text: 不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。教材以輸入電量乘總效率求接收電量，只描述能量帳，不把它當成電壓穩定或故障穿越分析。
knowledge.textEn: Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints. Multiplying input energy by overall efficiency describes the energy account only, not voltage stability or fault behavior.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「異頻換流能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asynchronous conversion energy" is correct?
options: 不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失
兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦
不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。
optionsEn: Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss.
An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating.
Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints.
quiz.explanation: 不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「異頻換流能量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asynchronous conversion energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。模型邊界：固定輸入及總傳輸效率，未計動態限制與停機。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Model boundary: constant input and overall transfer efficiency, excluding dynamic limits and outages. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。模型邊界：固定輸入及總傳輸效率，未計動態限制與停機。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Model boundary: constant input and overall transfer efficiency, excluding dynamic limits and outages.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「異頻換流能量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asynchronous conversion energy", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。
水舌動能數值可以直接當結構反力
頻率接近就足以證明發生共振
optionsEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh.
The numerical jet kinetic energy can directly be used as structural reaction force.
Frequency proximity alone is enough to prove resonance.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「異頻換流能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asynchronous conversion energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。把損失與功率、環境溫度及設備狀態作圖，若差額只在切換時段出現，應先查積分時間與計量路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries. Plot loss against power, ambient temperature and equipment state. A discrepancy confined to switching intervals calls for checking integration windows and meter paths before assigning a physical efficiency change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持送端電量相同，設定兩種負載效率曲線比較受端電量，再列出換流站與線路應分設哪些電表才能驗證各項損失。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold sending energy fixed and compare received energy under two load-dependent efficiency curves. Identify the converter and line meters needed to verify the individual loss components rather than only the final balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。把損失與功率、環境溫度及設備狀態作圖，若差額只在切換時段出現，應先查積分時間與計量路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries. Plot loss against power, ambient temperature and equipment state. A discrepancy confined to switching intervals calls for checking integration windows and meter paths before assigning a physical efficiency change.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持送端電量相同，設定兩種負載效率曲線比較受端電量，再列出換流站與線路應分設哪些電表才能驗證各項損失。
knowledge.textEn: Hold sending energy fixed and compare received energy under two load-dependent efficiency curves. Identify the converter and line meters needed to verify the individual loss components rather than only the final balance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「異頻換流能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asynchronous conversion energy"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。
可用台時減少一定等比例減少發電量
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries.
Reduced available unit-hours always reduce generation by the same proportion.
quiz.explanation: 比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「異頻換流能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asynchronous conversion energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. These accounting errors can cancel, so agreement in the final total still requires checking the physical boundary of every metered term. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：換流損失可包含固定輔助耗電及隨負載改變的部分，低負載效率因此未必與額定點相同，需保留負載曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conversion losses can include fixed auxiliaries and load-dependent components, making low-load efficiency differ from the rated point; retain the load curve in comparisons.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. These accounting errors can cancel, so agreement in the final total still requires checking the physical boundary of every metered term.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「異頻換流能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asynchronous conversion energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦
漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating.
Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it.
quiz.explanation: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
